timeline.action: Hossam notices that a bypass has overheated the stairwell feeder.
Fared changes the electrical log to conceal earlier bypass warnings.
Power fails in apartments and street-facing lights; UPS continues powering DVR and camera.
Mariam enters; CCTV clock is seven minutes fast.
Mariam confronts Fared about the bypass.
Glass breaks when Fared knocks a cup off the desk; nobody is hurt.
Fared leaves via a side service passage in a dark jacket; witness sees clothing, not face.
Mariam climbs the roof stairs carrying photographed log records.
Mariam crosses the connected roof landing to the shop storage room, asks Nabil for safety and keeps evidence.
Power is restored after Hossam isolates the unsafe bypass.

sources_of_uncertainty.camera_frame: CCTV embedded clock is seven minutes ahead; UPS-powered recorder survives outage.
sources_of_uncertainty.witness_coat: Witness could distinguish jacket, not face; side passage exits away from main entrance.
sources_of_uncertainty.glass: Broken cup does not establish assault.
sources_of_uncertainty.roof_marks: Footprints indicate use of roof route, but not their maker alone.

evidence.observed: Clock check against radio says DVR is 7 minutes fast.
Glass pieces beside desk, no confirmed blood or injuries.
A dark jacket passed by the side passage around 23:40; face not visible.
Fresh dust prints toward connected shop roof landing.
Nabil noted Mariam arriving at 23:47 and requesting help.
